hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import json, sys
try:
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
    fp = str(data.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')).lower()
    content = str(data.get('tool_input', {}).get('content', ''))
    cl = content.lower()
    is_draft = (any(k in fp for k in ['draft', 'email']) or ('subject:' in cl and 'to:' in cl) or ('subject:' in cl and '@' in content))
    if is_draft:
        print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': 'Hugo has written a draft email \u2014 check your drafts.'}))
except:
    pass
" 2>/dev/null || true
